rationale: The protobuf schema changed speed_mps from float to int32. In Python, the generated setter accepts float and truncates toward zero, matching the intended quantization semantics. The construction site (line 10) must pass an int to satisfy static type checkers and make the quantization explicit. The read site (line 12) compares the decoded int32 speed_mps to the threshold 30; changing 30.0 to 30 keeps the comparison purely integer and avoids any float precision concerns. The field access on line 11 reads the already-quantized integer value and is left unchanged.
assumptions: request['speed'] is a finite float representing meters per second
The generated protobuf setter for int32 fields truncates toward zero when given a float (standard protobuf Python behavior)
The threshold comparison remains strictly greater than 30 m/s after quantization
